title: S.R. Bommai v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: S.R. Bommai v. Union of India, (1994) 3 SCC 1
content.holding: 9-judge Bench declared Secularism to be an inviolable basic feature of the Constitution; politics and religion cannot be mixed by State governments.

evidence.note: 9-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Civil Appeal No. 3645 of 1989; 1994 INSC 173; (1994) 3 SCC 1; 1994 (2) SCR 644.
